---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for VoxFrontier
title: "[feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when [...]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen. For statistical/estimation features, please cite the
method (paper or textbook) so the implementation can follow the published
definition.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered, including other
packages.

**Methodological soundness checklist** (for estimation/inference features)
- [ ] The estimator has a published reference.
- [ ] Properties (consistency, coverage, test level) are stated or cited.
- [ ] It can be validated on synthetic data with a known ground truth.

**Additional context**
Any other context, sketches, or references.
